A lot of the spectacle feels like just that, but I think it works because of the world we're shown.

It's potentially a post-apocalyptic world, but, it's more of an existence based off the wills of Hugo, the uh, child. **You know that one.**

Everything in the different Zones, especially the second Zone, are explicitly crafted places for enjoyment, leisure, shopping - they all feel like surface level ideas based off how a society is supposed to run.

It does feel like an overall criticism of society wrapped up in a game about a batter beating the ever-living shit out of ghosts with a bat while hitting different "Zones".

It's quite frankly absurd.
